title: Who Took the Champion?

objectives.text: Catch the coop thief on the roofs

traversal.at: over a coop's wire run (birds everywhere)
a narrow gap to a tenement roof, laundry lines across it
up a water tank's ladder; he's hiding the shoebox up there
off the tank platform onto the tar

objectives.traversalMobile: One context button (climb/vault/tackle), auto-aligned. No precise timing. The quarry rubber-bands (never more than ~40 m ahead), so no timer fails the player.

objectives.text: The champion back to Hallisey's coop

rewards.payNote: Hallisey pays in cash and a race tip.

mobile: Missed jumps catch the ledge; no fall death.
